summary: Short dead-end lane end with parked cars, under trees, beside a building site.
reasons: Homes 14-37 m away, none within 10 m
Cars already park at the lane end

drivers.seclusion: Nearest dwellings are 14 m (at the far end) and 24 m; the first 12 m has homes 37 m or more away. Bush behind, building site to the east.

drivers.traffic: Dead-end spur, very little through traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars parked on the apron in both images; 2P Mon-Fri 9-5 signs, so stay is only restricted in the day.

flags: Building site beside it, daytime noise and workers
Witton Creek 93 m, elevation about 24 m
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over the north end; open to the east and afternoon sun on the apron.
cannot_judge: Whether the apron is public road or private

best_section.where: Goldieslie Road, tarmac lane end under the big tree
